title: Waiver Share Schedule for Courtesy Waivers
content:
The waiver share of an Apartment Home Lease courtesy waiver follows how long the rent took to be brought current, counted in calendar days from the start of the lateness clock to the date of the latest lease payment received: more than 20 days gives a waiver share of 0.60, 11 to 20 days gives a waiver share of 0.80, and 10 days or fewer leaves the whole.

| Calendar days from the start of the lateness clock to the latest lease payment | Waiver share |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | 0.60 (60%) |
| 11 to 20 | 0.80 (80%) |
| 10 or fewer | the whole, 1 (100%) |

### Schedule notes

1. The latest lease payment is the most recent payment received on the lease ledger, whatever its instrument; its date ends the count.
2. The count is the number of calendar days from the day the lateness clock starts to that payment date.

### Boundary illustration (hypothetical, lateness clock starting 1 March)

| Latest lease payment dated | Days | Waiver share |
|---|---|---|
| 11 March | 10 | the whole |
| 12 March | 11 | 0.80 |
| 21 March | 20 | 0.80 |
| 22 March | 21 | 0.60 |
